landing.badge: Free forever. Every business. One place.
landing.headline: Every business in the world. In one place.
landing.subheadline: Find, compare, and contact any business — from street food to photo booths to barbershops. Owners get a beautiful storefront, free.
landing.categoriesSub: Every category that exists. One directory.
landing.howStep1Text: Search, filter, or explore the map. Compare businesses side by side before you choose.
landing.howStep2Text: Like, review, recommend, and chat. Real signals surface what's truly good — and hidden gems rise.
landing.howStep3Text: Business owners build a full storefront with products, branding, and chat — zero code, zero cost.
landing.featureSearchText: Full-text search with filters for category, location, price, rating, and open-now. Results on a list or a map.
landing.featureTrendingText: Time-weighted engagement drives leaderboards. Rising tier gives new businesses a real chance to be found.
landing.featureStorefrontText: Themes, sections, products with variants and pricing. Every page unique, published by the owner.
landing.featureChatText: Chat with any business or user: media, replies, reactions, receipts. Real conversations, no apps to install.
landing.featureVerificationText: Document-backed verification with two trust levels, so you know who you are dealing with.
landing.featureCategoriesText: Category-agnostic by design: food, photo booths, barbers, studios — every business in the world fits.
landing.ownerCtaText: Claim your free storefront in minutes. Products, branding, chat — everything your customers need.
